profile.bio: My research interests are in biomass-to-biofuels processes, biological systems, and environmental water quality control. Prior to my appointment at the Hong Kong PolyU, I was as a Postdoctoral Fellow at the Forest Products Laboratory (FPL) of the United States Department of Agriculture from 2011 to 2013. My research in FPL was on converting forest residues into biofuels and useful by-products. I obtained my Bachelor’s and Master’s Degrees from the Forestry Department of National Taiwan University.
